FULL TEXT:
GOVERNMENT OF MANIPUR
OFFICE OF THE DEPUTY COMMISSIONER, PHERZAWL DISTRICT
PUBLIC NOTICE
Pherzawl, the 5th May, 2026
No. 05/22/2023-DC/PZL: In pursuance of Government of Manipur’s Tourism
Department notice no. 6/362/2024-DTSM dated 02.05.2026, it is hereby notified for information
to all interested & eligible youth (unmarried male & female) of Pherzawl District that the
Directorate of Tourism, Government of Manipur in partnership with M/S Primero Skill and Training
Pvt. Ltd. Is organizing a ‘Cabin Crew & Hospitality Sector Training Programme’ as detailed
below:
Training location New Delhi
Fees Funded by the Government (Residential, Boarding & Training costs)
Duration Approximately 2 (two) months/75 days
Eligibility 1. Indian National and Domicile of Manipur (Possession or proof of
application of Indian Passport mandatory for Cabin Crew)
2. Identity Proof (PAN Card/Aadhaar/any other valid documents)
3. Domicile Certificate/IDP Certificate/any ors. (from concerned SDOs)
4. Completed 10+2 or above from a recognized board/university with at
least 50% marks (for Cabin Crew) & 10th Passed (for Hospitality Sector
Training)
5. Communication: Proficiency in English & Hindi essential
6. Appearance: Positive body language, pleasing personality with no
visible tattoo.
7. For Cabin Crew: Minimum height of 155 cm and BMI below 21
(approx.)
Age 1. Cabin Crew: 18 to 26 years
2. Others: 18 to 30 years
Travel Cost To be borne by the candidate themselves (Travel cost for IDPs will be borne
by the Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Pherzawl)
Application form is downloadable at https://pherzawl.nic.in and submission of duly filled
forms along with requisite documents can be done at Room No. 24, First Floor, Deputy
Commissioner’s Camp Office, M Songgel, Tuibong on or before 15th May, 2026 (Friday, 12:00
Noon).
(Zosanglur Joute)
Addl. Deputy Commissioner,
Pherzawl District
Copy to:
1. Staff Officer to Chief Secretary, Government of Manipur
2. Director, Tourism Department, Government of Manipur
3. SDOs/BDOs, Pherzawl District –
for wide circulation among IDPs and jurisdictions
4. DIO(DIPR), Pherzawl –
for wide publicity and circulation
